title: Herald Follow-Up: "Missing Vials" on Lindgren Four

fields.subject: Follow-up: Lindgren 'missing vials' and select agents — deadline 11:30 AM
fields.body:
Hi,

Following up on my 10:08 message about Lindgren. We haven't heard back yet.

Two sources now tell us that a lab on Lindgren's fourth floor is "missing vials" from a freezer, and that someone there mentioned select agents.

Can you answer three questions on the record?

1. Is HSU reporting a loss to the CDC or any other federal agency?
2. Is the freezer issue connected to this morning's third-floor incident, where we understand a student was taken to the clinic?
3. Are students and staff in Lindgren at any risk right now, and should they stay out of the building?

For context, the post about the taped-off door is spreading. @lindgren_late_nights's post is now at 140 reposts, and a reply from @corn_and_code reads: "so they lost SELECT AGENTS and a student got exposed the same day?? that's literally a lab leak #HSU". We will mention how far it has spread in our story whether or not we get a comment. We'd much rather include the university's account.

Our deadline is still 11:30 for the noon web update. If we don't hear back by then, we'll report that HSU did not respond to requests for comment.

Thanks,

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject. Watch whether the PIO checks the claim with the BSO before replying and answers the Herald by 11:30. The answer should say only that HSU holds no select agents and that a review is under way, without naming the worker, the lab or the organism. Also watch whether the IO approves that stance, whether the 3-hour holding statement is started (due about 12:20) and whether anyone pushes for an HSUAlert that isn't needed.
